messages:
jen (eng-releases): Heads up — proposing we unpin runtime v3.2 from the canary pool at 09:30 UTC for the staged rollout today. Reason: 3.3 has a lengthy KV-cache change that regressed a subset of quantized models; we want to validate v3.2 behavior in canary first.

sanjay (eng-runtime): quick note — runtime v3.2 and SDK 2.8 are the only verified pair for long-seq Llama variants. If any customers are on SDK 2.9 we'll need to either pin SDK or ensure compatibility shim.

maria (qa): maria here — can we run long-seq prompt suite on the canary cluster before full unpin? I already queued `canary/longseq/regression` test across two models (llama3q-quant, gptx-lite). ETA ~20m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Can initiate unpin window. Current canary capacity: 12 nodes free, 4 active canaries. To proceed run `/deploy unpin runtime v3.3 --target canary --stagger 10m`.

jen (eng-releases): thanks — plan: (1) run QA tests, (2) start staggered unpin to canary only, (3) monitor token-error-rate and tail-latency for 30m, (4) roll to staging if green. If regression observed, rollback plan B.

maria (qa): test results: llama3q-quant longseq failed 2/120 on token continuity (same diff as earlier regression), gptx-lite passed. Logs attached:```
llama3q-quant | prompt_id=476 | mismatch at token 1024
trace: kv-cache mismatch between runtime v3.3 and model checkpoint
```

sanjay (eng-runtime): ok that's the signal — v3.3 introduced a KV alignment optimization that shifts chunk boundaries for quant kernels. For now we should keep v3.2 pinned for any models using `quant-v2` profile. We can unpin models without that profile.

lisa (platform): inventory check: customers on quant-v2 profiles in canary/staging: catalog shows 3 internal test tenants + 1 early access customer `acme-ai`. @tom any concerns about rolling to staging with acme live?

tom (sre): tom here — acme-ai is low traffic in staging but prod is high. If acme is in canary path we should notify them. Also we need a rollback ticket ready: `RB-17577` created.

jen (eng-releases): decision: DO NOT unpin globally. Proceed with targeted unpin for models NOT using `quant-v2`. Steps: (A) QA confirm negative on canary for non-quant models (maria), (B) run `/deploy unpin runtime v3.3 --target canary --filter "!profile:quant-v2" --stagger 10m` (deploy-bot), (C) monitor metrics for 30m, (D) if no regressions, unpin staging with same filters. If any regressions, immediate rollback to v3.3 pin via `/deploy pin runtime v3.3 --all`.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. Command prepared:```
/deploy unpin runtime v3.3 --target canary --filter "!profile:quant-v2" --stagger 10m
```

maria (qa): re-run queued tests but scoped to non-quant models. ETA 15m. Will post pass/fail snapshot.

sanjay (eng-runtime): follow-up — we should add a short-term compatibility flag in the SDK that forces older KV semantics when talking to v3.3. I'll open an RFC but not blocking the staged unpin.

lisa (platform): I'll message `acme-ai` POC: FYI scheduled canary change, safe-filter applied.

maria (qa): non-quant test suite green: 0 failures (200/200). Snapshot: `gs://redwood-ci/canary/1757778888/non-quant/summary.html`

tom (sre): metrics watchlist configured: token-error-rate, kv-error-count, tail-p95-latency. Alert thresholds set to +3 sigma from baseline in canary accounts. Slack alert channel `#runtime-watch` added.

jen (eng-releases): executing unpin now (deploy-bot run). We'll wait 10m before next wave. Everyone stand by, escalate to `#oncall` if anything noisy. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started unpin wave 1/3 -> 4 canary nodes. Wave schedule: 10m interval.

maria (qa): monitoring logs/outputs. No anomalies in first wave after 12m.

sanjay (eng-runtime): quick runbook reminder in case of KV errors: rollback steps are 1) `/deploy pin runtime v3.3 --all`, 2) drain affected queues, 3) revert SDK compatibility flags if any. Keep RB ticket open.

jen (eng-releases): after wave 2/3 we saw a small bump in kv-error-count +0.6 sigma for one internal test tenant; rolled back that tenant by routing to pinned v3.3 model variant. No customer impact. Deciding to continue with final wave but extend monitoring to 60m.

tom (sre): confirmed rollback routing worked and no pager. Good call.

lisa (platform): notified `acme-ai` and they acknowledged. No complaints.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Completed wave 3/3 for non-quant filter. Canary unpin finished.

jen (eng-releases): summary: partial unpin successful for non-quant models. Action items: 1) sanjay to draft SDK shim RFC (due EOD), 2) runtime team to add an opt-in `kv_legacy` flag for quant kernels, 3) platform to update pinlist exemption rules to auto-exclude `quant-v2` models from future unpins. I've recorded notes in the rollout doc: `docs/internal/unpins/1757778888.md`.

sanjay (eng-runtime): acknowledged, will start RFC and PR today.

maria (qa): will run a full regression sweep tomorrow on staging including customer-like prompt mix.

jen (eng-releases): closing thread — will reopen if any post-rollout issues surface. Great job team. :tada:
